seoTitle: Share of Voice Calculator: Brand vs Competitors
metaDescription: Calculate share of voice from mentions, spend or impressions for your brand and competitors, as percentages with bars. Free and private.
intro: Enter a value per brand to get each brand's share and a bar chart.
why:
Share of voice divides your number by the total of all listed brands. It works for any single metric, such as mentions, ad spend or impressions.

The share depends on which competitors you include, so keep the set stable between periods. Use the same metric and period for every brand.
howTo: Enter one line per brand as Name: value.
Give your own brand name to mark it.
Repeat each period with the same brands.

faq.a: Any, if it is the same for all brands.
Maybe a new competitor was added.
